inlines.v: DIVINELY, adverb 1. In a divine or godlike manner; in a manner resembling deity. 2. By the agency or influence of God; as a prophet divinely inspired; divinely taught. 3. Excellently; in the supreme degree; as divinely fair; divinely brave.
